name: Summer Programs at Walnut Hill
operator_name: Walnut Hill School for the Arts
description_short: Walnut Hill School for the Arts runs two summer programs on its Natick campus. The new Arts Day Camp (launching 2027) is a two-week, multi-disciplinary arts day camp for ages 4 through rising 6th grade, 8:30am–3:30pm. Summer Arts Intensives are one- to three-week programs for students going into grades 6–12, by application or audition, in film, voice, strings, brass, visual art, comics, fashion, theater and dance.

warnings: Summer 2027 programs have not been announced yet ('Summer 2027 offerings are coming soon!'). The programs listed are from 2026, so season_year is set to 2026.
This is an overview page for several separate programs, each with its own page. The page gives no dates, prices, ages or session details for any of them.
The gallery captions refer to Summer 2024, and some programs pictured there (e.g., Chamber Music for Global Young Musicians) are not in the current list.
The page title says 'Arts Boarding School Summer Program', but the page does not say whether summer students stay overnight or come for the day.
The phone number is the school's general contact number, not one specific to the summer programs.

refund_policy_summary: Arts Day Camp: a non-refundable $100/week deposit holds the spot. Cancel before April 15, 2027 for a full refund or credit minus the deposit; April 15 to June 1 for 50% minus the deposit; nothing after June 1. Summer Arts Intensives use the same dates with a non-refundable 25% deposit.
